correctness.rationale: The Weierstrass model has I9+3I1 fibers and a flex section of order three; Shioda–Tate and the unimodular Néron–Severi lattice yield exactly three sections. Height pairings position these on components 0,3,6. Adjunction and nefness prove the 12-curve exhaustion. Schur-complement analysis classifies precisely the 10 minimal semidefinite obstructions; the full 4096-mask exact arithmetic verification independently agrees, giving coefficient vector (1,12,66,220,492,768,837,612,270,48,0,0,0) and sum 3326. No inference from incomplete finite samples.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete chamber-support classification for the semistable extremal rational elliptic surface with an I9 cycle and order-three torsion sections. The ten forbidden configurations give a structural criterion for every possible big-divisor negative support and yield the full polynomial, not merely a numerical increment. Such support distributions encode the piecewise decomposition of the big cone and stable-base-locus possibilities. Scope is precisely delimited; no new general algorithm is asserted.
